## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation or specification
- [ ] Architecture decision record
- [ ] Chart, image or compose
- [ ] Version bump in `versions.yaml`

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin)
- [ ] `make lint` passes locally
- [ ] A specification change is reflected in an ADR, new or updated
- [ ] A version bump has `status: proposed` until CI verifies it
- [ ] No new dependency outside the license allow list in `docs/03-bill-of-materials.md`
